name: TabRecSet (tables in the wild)
description: Photographed and scanned tables, many deformed or skewed, with table structure and cell content. English and Chinese.
redistribution: yes, with attribution and share-alike for adaptations; not redistributed here
download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (figshare.com)
notes: ShareAlike: fine for evaluation (nothing shipped); confirm with the orchestrator before shipping anything derived.
phone-photos-hard: not assigned from TabRecSet, because the annotations carry no capture-condition label; all pages count as tables.

The figshare file list could not be read from the sandbox (shell and web fetch both refused). fetch_pack resolves it from the figshare API and stops with the file list if the name pattern does not match exactly one archive.
Generated border-incomplete copies share file names with their originals, so only originals are used (no copy of a held-out table can be in dev).

pack.page_addressing: page ID = image file stem of an English original (not a generated three-line/no-line copy); annotation = TSR_TCR_annotation JSON with the same stem (labelme shapes, label '<row>-<col>-<rowspan>-<colspan>-<text>', group_id = table)

estimate.how: range reads: central directory (~15 MB, estimated) + 75 images and annotations; file name and size resolved from the figshare API on first run (figshare could not be read from the sandbox)
